title: My Cat Answers Every Single Kiss 🥺
description:
My cat answers every single kiss. Watch what happens after each one. 🥺
I kiss my cat’s head, the eyes squint shut, and then comes a wide-eyed look up and a very chatty reply. Six kisses, six meows back. Is it a thank-you, a complaint, or a request for more?
Tell me what you think my cat is saying in the comments 👇
